paragraphs.text:
Suddenly tiny men are in the bushes all around you. A flurry of 
darts rain in on your party. You yell as you return fire, trying to 
marshal the students into an organized retreat.

Bernard cries out, clutching a dart lodged in his breast. He 
falls and you rush to his aid. His limbs stiffen and his fingers 
splay. The darts must be poisoned. You cannot stay and you 
cannot carry him.
